optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Recommendation Systems Engineer, Customer Identity Verification
professionalSummary: Trained a next‑best‑check recommendation model using gradient‑boosted ranking over device, document and behavioural signals and evaluated it offline against the previous rule set on three months of held‑out verification sessions. (src_f1b79d8566ee)

Deployed model versions 2.3 and 2.4 to production through the model release pipeline, executing canary rollouts under the platform team’s release calendar and holding the production deployment role for the verification service. (src_9390a544bb81)

Operated the model in production for eleven months, monitoring completion rate, fraud‑catch rate and feature drift on the production dashboard, and rolled back version 2.4 once after a drift alert, recording the incident in the model incident log. (src_f8934030d614)
Coordinated each release with the platform and compliance teams in the release review; compliance signed the model change record and the platform lead approved the rollout window. (src_3622aca52932)
Documented model cards, known limitations and hand‑over conditions for each model version. (src_fc53e229510c)
experienceHighlights: Trained next‑best‑check model and evaluated offline against previous rule set. (src_f1b79d8566ee)
Deployed model versions 2.3 and 2.4 to production via model release pipeline. (src_9390a544bb81)
Operated model in production for eleven months, monitoring key metrics and handling rollback. (src_f8934030d614)
Coordinated releases with platform and compliance teams. (src_3622aca52932)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Model card for version 2.4 detailing training data window, evaluation metrics and known limitations. (src_fc53e229510c)
Production incident log entry for version 2.4 rollback with release pipeline run identifiers. (src_fc53e229510c)
